Turning on background data collection allows Gleamvox to record gestures you type in other apps. This is very useful for the gesture typing project as it can produce a considerable amount of data, albeit at lower quality than active gathering. Background data collection is not a replacement for actively gathered data, it is meant to be an addition, as data quality is more important than quantity.

 Background gathering has high potential of collecting data that you may consider too private to share, even when published anonymously. For this reason we want to clarify when gesture data is being gathered, and how you can influence it.

 You can find a video explaining more about background data gathering in the links section at the bottom right of this screen.

Gleamvox features
Dictate without leaving the keyboard. Needs the microphone; speech is recognized by the Android speech service, Gleamvox keeps no sound.

Only the requests of Gleamvox to OpenAI go through it; voice input and everything else are not affected. Useful if OpenAI is reachable only through a VPN or tunnel app: then Gleamvox does not have to be added to the VPN.
If OpenAI works on this phone only through a VPN: add Gleamvox to the VPN, or set the local proxy port of your VPN app below (then voice input keeps working without the VPN).

The connection to OpenAI failed the certificate check. If your VPN or proxy replaces certificates with its own, Gleamvox does not trust such a connection, for your safety. Use a VPN mode without certificate replacement, or the proxy for OpenAI requests.
Daily ceiling of Gleamvox for ✨ and cleanup (0 = no AI text requests). Counted only on this phone, nothing is sent anywhere. Also set a monthly spending limit on the OpenAI site.

When you dictate, the recording of your voice is sent to OpenAI with your own API key; OpenAI charges it by its price list to the balance of this key. Gleamvox does not keep the sound: it is only in the phone memory and is wiped right after sending. Gleamvox has no server of its own.
Allow the microphone for Gleamvox, then press again.
Internet access is off in Gleamvox
Voice, ✨ and the cleanup of dictation work with your own OpenAI API key. Gleamvox has no server of its own and stores nothing outside this phone.

When you tap a ✨ command, the selected part or the text of the field is sent to OpenAI with your own API key. When the cleanup of dictation is on, the text of each dictated phrase is sent for cleanup. OpenAI charges it by its price list to the balance of your key. Gleamvox keeps no text and has no server of its own.

Voice with punctuation, the ✨ button (fix, rewrite, shorten, translate) and the cleanup of dictation from “uh” and filler words. The sound of a dictated phrase and the text you send with ✨ or by dictation go to OpenAI with your API key; OpenAI charges it by its price list to the balance of this key. Gleamvox keeps nothing and has no server of its own.
